body: 第一张为橙色灯芯绒沙发参考，第二张为目标客厅。用第一张沙发替换第二张图中的蓝绿色沙发，放在同一位置，匹配透视、尺度和光照，保持橙色灯芯绒、圆扶手和短木脚。移除旧沙发及其抱枕，其他窗门、桌子、花瓶、地毯、灯、墙和地板全部不变。4:3。

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

The orange corduroy sofa replaces the teal sofa and its cushions; the remaining room arrangement and daylight are preserved.
